# Flowify

> Beautiful, ChatGPT-quality chat interfaces for n8n workflows and AI agents.

Flowify turns an n8n webhook endpoint into a production-ready, shareable chat interface without coding. It supports streaming responses, markdown, brand presets, custom colors, fonts, avatars and quick-start prompts, and lets you manage many chat interfaces from one multi-tenant dashboard. Flowify is open source (MIT) and can be self-hosted.

Built for n8n users, automation builders and agencies who want to put a polished chat front end on their AI workflows.
